usdRate.note: The EC dollar has been fixed at 2.70 per US dollar by the Eastern Caribbean Central Bank since 1976.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: ECCB, Consumer Price Index Saint Lucia (Central Statistical Office data)
inflation_cpi.note: All-items index 125.25 in June 2026 against 118.88 in June 2025 (computed year on year; the table's monthly 'inflation rate' column is month on month). The jump is driven by housing and utilities; December-to-December inflation was 0.33% in 2025 and the 2025 average 2.03%. June 2026 is the latest month published.

inflation_projection.sourceName: ECCB CPI Saint Lucia: period-average inflation 2021-2025 of 2.4%, 9.7%, 3.8%, -0.7% and 2.0%; EC dollar pegged at 2.70 per US dollar
inflation_projection.note: The ECCB has no inflation target (the EC dollar is pegged to the US dollar), so we plan with 2.5%: close to US-dollar inflation, nudged up for the volatile, import-driven Saint Lucia CPI (5-year average about 3.4% including the 2022 shock).

policy_rate.sourceName: ECCB, Interest Rates on Deposits and Loans: Saint Lucia (discount rate)
policy_rate.note: ECCB discount rate 3.00% (May-August 2026), the same for all ECCU members; with the peg it is a backstop rate rather than an active policy tool.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: ECCB, Interest Rates and Weighted Average Rates on Deposits and Loans: Saint Lucia
savings_account_rate.note: Weighted average rate on EC-dollar savings deposits 2.07% in June 2026; posted savings rates 2.00-3.00%, with the ECCB 2% minimum savings rate as the floor.

fdr_3m_rate.note: The ECCB interest rate table for Saint Lucia shows no 3-month time-deposit rate ('---' through August 2026); 6-month deposits were quoted at 1.30-2.50%.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: ECCB, Interest Rates and Weighted Average Rates on Deposits and Loans: Saint Lucia
fdr_1y_rate.note: Posted 12-month EC-dollar time-deposit rates ranged 0.10-2.50% (May-August 2026); the weighted average on all EC-dollar time deposits was 1.64% in June 2026, used here as the typical rate.

dps_rate.note: Searched the ECCB interest rate tables for Saint Lucia: no monthly recurring deposit product rate is published.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: ECCB, Interest Rates and Weighted Average Rates on Deposits and Loans: Saint Lucia
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Weighted average rate on all EC-dollar deposits 1.19% in June 2026 (1.08% including foreign-currency deposits); World Bank deposit rate 1.18% (2025).

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found; the Government of Saint Lucia borrows through Treasury bills and bonds auctioned on the Regional Government Securities Market.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: ECCB, Weighted Average Interest Rates on the RGSM: Saint Lucia
tbill_91d_rate.note: 91-day Treasury bill weighted average 2.95% at the September 2026 auction (3.00% in June 2026; 2.71% average in 2025).

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: ECCB, Weighted Average Interest Rates on the RGSM: Saint Lucia (annual)
tbond_5y_rate.note: Weighted average yield on 5-year Government of Saint Lucia bonds issued in 2025 was 5.67% (5.75% in 2024); no 5-year bond was auctioned in May-September 2026.

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: ECCB, Weighted Average Interest Rates on the RGSM: Saint Lucia (annual)
tbond_10y_rate.note: Weighted average yield on 10-year Government of Saint Lucia bonds issued in 2024 was 7.15% (6.99% in 2023); none was issued in 2025 or May-September 2026, so the figure is older than 2025.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Saint Lucia: Individual - Income determination
tax_bank_interest.note: Interest from banks in Saint Lucia is exempt from income tax (page last reviewed 12 October 2026).

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate for individuals exists in Saint Lucia (see sanchayapatra_5y_rate), so no tax rate applies.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: Searched ECCB sources: the regional Eastern Caribbean deposit insurance arrangement is not shown as operating, and no deposit insurance cover limit for Saint Lucia was found.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap on credit card interest was found; the ECCB publishes only an 'other lending rates' range of 3.50-25.00% for Saint Lucia (August 2026).

equity_return_low.sourceName: ECCB RGSM: Saint Lucia 91-day Treasury bill 2.95% (September 2026)
equity_return_low.note: Low case: the regional share market is very small, so savers rely mostly on global equity funds in pegged US-dollar terms, and a weak decade is possible.

equity_return_base.sourceName: ECCB RGSM: Saint Lucia 91-day Treasury bill 2.95% (September 2026)
equity_return_base.note: Base case uses a global equity index in EC-dollar terms (pegged to the US dollar): about the 3% tax-free safe rate plus a 3.5-point premium, as the local market is too thin to have a usable 10-year record.

equity_return_high.sourceName: ECCB RGSM: Saint Lucia 91-day Treasury bill 2.95% (September 2026)
equity_return_high.note: High case if global equities repeat their strong long-run US-dollar returns.

gold_return_low.sourceName: ECCB: EC dollar fixed at 2.70 per US dollar; World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF 2.70 (2025)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: weak dollar gold price, and the long-standing peg gives no currency boost.

gold_return_base.sourceName: ECCB: EC dollar fixed at 2.70 per US dollar; World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF 2.70 (2025)
gold_return_base.note: Long-run dollar gold trend of about 4-5% a year, with no expected depreciation of the pegged EC dollar.

gold_return_high.sourceName: ECCB: EC dollar fixed at 2.70 per US dollar; World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF 2.70 (2025)
gold_return_high.note: High case with strong dollar gold prices.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: ECCB Saint Lucia: weighted average time-deposit rate 1.64% and savings rate 2.07% (June 2026)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: savings and time deposits at about 1.5-2%, tax-free for residents.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: ECCB Saint Lucia: savings rate 2.07% (June 2026); 91-day Treasury bill 2.95% (September 2026)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: a mix of tax-free savings deposits around 2% and Treasury bills near 3%.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: ECCB RGSM Saint Lucia: 91-day bill 2.95%, 180-day bill 3.00-4.00% (2026)
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: rolling 91- and 180-day Treasury bills at 3-4%.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: Searched the Financial Services Regulatory Authority statistics: it publishes long-term insurance income and expense statements (2011-2022) but no claim settlement ratio.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life cover is sold in Saint Lucia by regional insurers, but no regulator or other non-company source publishes premium rates by age.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: Searched Ministry of Health and statistics sources: no published typical cost of a major private hospital stay in Saint Lucia was found.

health_premium_table.note: No regulator or other non-company source publishing private health insurance premiums by age was found for Saint Lucia.

oop_health_share.note: Out-of-pocket spending was 37.1% of current health expenditure in 2023 (latest available; older than 2025).

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: ECCB CPI Saint Lucia: health index 110.25 (2021) to 127.26 (2025), about 3.7% a year
goal_inflation_health.note: Health prices rose about 3.7% a year in 2021-2025, above headline; we plan with 4% to allow for private and overseas treatment costs.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: ECCB CPI Saint Lucia: education index 98.30 (2021) to 88.80 (2025)
goal_inflation_education.note: The CPI education index fell in 2021-2025 (public schooling is largely free), but private and overseas tertiary costs rise faster, so we plan with planning inflation plus half a point.

life_expectancy.note: Men 69.5, women 76.5 (2024). UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net gives 73.2 for 2026 (men 69.7, women 76.7).

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; sex-specific values are for the 5-year age groups starting at each age; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 13.7 (2025, World Bank), 23.8 (2040) and 48.8 (2065, populationpyramid.net/saint-lucia/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: National Insurance Corporation Saint Lucia, Retirement Benefit
retirement_age_default.note: Age pension from 65 with at least 180 months of contributions; the Labour Code 2006 s.159 sets the retirement age of all employees at the NIC pensionable age. Same for men and women. The page carries no date (read October 2026).

retirement_age_government.note: Searched Government of Saint Lucia sources: the statutory retirement age for public officers under the Pensions Act could not be confirmed from a readable official page.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: ECCB Saint Lucia: weighted average time-deposit rate 1.64% (June 2026)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: mostly tax-free savings and time deposits at about 1.5-2%.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: ECCB Saint Lucia: savings rate 2.07% (June 2026); 91-day Treasury bill 2.95% (September 2026)
retirement_return_base.note: Base case below the 2.95% tax-free Treasury bill rate: a mix of savings deposits and bills, kept liquid in retirement.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: ECCB RGSM: Saint Lucia 91-day Treasury bill 2.95% (September 2026)
retirement_return_high.note: High case: rolling Treasury bills at about the latest auction rate.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: 91-day Treasury bill 2.95%; global equity assumptions in pegged EC dollars
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix if global equities disappoint.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: 91-day Treasury bill 2.95%; global equity assumptions in pegged EC dollars
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: half global equities at 6.5% and half deposits and bills around 2.5%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: 91-day Treasury bill 2.95%; global equity assumptions in pegged EC dollars
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case with stronger equity returns.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: HelpAge Pension Watch (https://www.helpage.org/country_profile/saint-lucia/) states that Saint Lucia does not currently have a social pension (0% of people 60+ receive one); poor older people can only apply for means-tested public assistance.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age pension exists in Saint Lucia (HelpAge Pension Watch, https://www.helpage.org/country_profile/saint-lucia/).

gratuity_rule.note: No statutory retirement gratuity: the Labour Code 2006 (https://www.govt.lc/media.govt.lc/www/resources/legislation/SaintLuciaLabourCode2006.pdf) gives redundancy pay only on redundancy (s.160) and not to an employee who chooses to retire (s.162(1)(g)); severance is left to collective agreements until regulations are made (s.161).

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: National Insurance Corporation Saint Lucia, Retirement Benefit and FAQ
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory NIC for employed and self-employed people aged 16 to 65 (10% of insurable earnings up to EC$5,000 a month, split equally). Age pension from 65 with 180 months of contributions: 40% of average pensionable earnings in the best 5 years plus 0.1% per month beyond 180; minimum EC$500 a month; fewer contributions give a lump-sum grant. No automatic indexation is stated; tax treatment not confirmed. Pages carry no date.

savings_account.note: ECCB minimum savings rate 2%; weighted average 2.07% (June 2026).

fdr_3m.note: Banks in Saint Lucia report no 3-month time-deposit rate to the ECCB; the shortest quoted term is 6 months (1.30-2.50%).

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product with a published rate.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found.

tbill_91d.localNameEn: Government of Saint Lucia 91-day Treasury bill
tbill_91d.note: Auctioned on the Regional Government Securities Market through licensed intermediaries; mostly bought by institutions.

tbond_5y.note: Issued occasionally on the Regional Government Securities Market (2024 and 2025).

tbond_10y.note: Issued occasionally on the Regional Government Securities Market (2022-2024; none since).

equity_fund.note: No locally registered retail equity or index fund was identified; the regional share market is very small.

gold.note: No legal restriction on buying gold; mostly sold as jewellery.

centralBank.name: Eastern Caribbean Central Bank (ECCB)
centralBank.note: Shared central bank of the Eastern Caribbean Currency Union.

insuranceComplaints.name: Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA), complaints
insuranceComplaints.note: No separate insurance ombudsman; complaints about regulated insurers go to the FSRA.

publicHealthCover.name: Ministry of Health, Wellness and Nutrition (public hospitals and wellness centres)
publicHealthCover.note: No national health insurance yet; a draft Universal Health Coverage Bill was published for consultation in October 2026.

statistics.name: Central Statistical Office of Saint Lucia
